item.vehicle_restored.spray_can.info: A tool that is used to paint vehicles. To add a color to the spray can, combine it with one or more dyes in a crafting table. You can also refill spray cans by placing them with a non-colored spray can in a crafting table.
item.vehicle_restored.jerry_can.info: A fluid storage item that is used for transporting fluids and pouring fuel. It can hold the equivalent of five buckets.
item.vehicle_restored.industrial_jerry_c: A fluid storage item that is used for transporting fuel or any other form of fluid. It can hold the equivalent of fifteen buckets.
item.vehicle_restored.wrench.info: A tool that is used for changing parts on a vehicle, opening Vehicle Crates, and changing the power mode on Fluid Pumps.
item.vehicle_restored.key.info: An item that is used to lock vehicles and prevent other players from driving them. Not all vehicles can be locked with a Key. To unlock a vehicle, the correct Key must be placed in the key port on the locked vehicle.
item.vehicle_restored.hammer.info: A tool that is used for repairing vehicles. Simply right click a damaged vehicle that is placed on a Jack to repair it. It can also be used as a weapon!
block.vehicle_restored.boost_pad.info: Gives your vehicle a speed boost when driving on this block.
block.vehicle_restored.boost_ramp.info: Gives your vehicle a speed boost and sends your vehicle into the air when driving on this block.
Gives your vehicle a speed boost and sends your vehicle high into the air when driving on this block.
block.vehicle_restored.traffic_cone.info: A simple cosmetic block for managing your roads. It has a tall collision box like fences to prevent vehicles driving over them.
block.vehicle_restored.fluid_pipe.info: Used to create a fluid link from a Fluid Pump to other fluid containers. Connections can be removed with a Wrench. If powered by redstone, the pipe will become disabled and prevent fluid from being transferred through it. Fluid pipes do not store fluid inside them.
block.vehicle_restored.fluid_pump.info: Used to pump fluids through a fluid link, which are created by Fluid Pipes. The pump will only work if the fluid link is connected to at least one fluid storage. The Fluid Pump has three different power modes which can be changed with a Wrench.
block.vehicle_restored.fuel_drum.info: A storage block that can be used to store Fuelium or any other form of fluid. It is highly explosive, so keep it away from fire.
block.vehicle_restored.industrial_fuel_d: A large storage block that can be used to store Fuelium or any other form of fluid. It is highly explosive, so keep it away from fire.
block.vehicle_restored.vehicle_crate.inf: A crate containing a %s. To open the crate, simply right click the top with a wrench.
block.vehicle_restored.jack.info: A block used to modify parts and repair a vehicle. A vehicle can be placed on a Jack by sneaking and right clicking a vehicle then right clicking the top of the Jack. You'll also need a Wrench to change the parts.
block.vehicle_restored.workstation.info: A new type of crafting table specifically for creating vehicles. You'll need all the required items in your inventory to craft vehicles.
block.vehicle_restored.gas_pump.info: An alternate utility used for fueling vehicles. To fuel vehicles, simply right click the nozzle on the side and hold right click while hovering the fuel port on a vehicle. There needs to be fuel in the lower tank for the fueling function to work.
block.vehicle_restored.fluid_extractor.i: A machine used for extracting and converting items into a fluid. Extracted fluid can be pumped out using a Fluid Pump. Machine is powered just like a Furnace.
block.vehicle_restored.fluid_mixer.info: A machine used for combining two fluids to create a new fluid. Mixing may require an additional item to be used in the combining process. Fluid can be pumped into the machine with a Fluid Pipe or directly with a filled bucket. Machine is powered just like a Furnace.
vehicle_restored.config.title: Vehicle Restored Config
vehicle_restored.config.client.debug.ren: If true, renders an outline of all the elements on a vehicle's model. Useful for debugging interactions.
If true, renders lines to help visualise steering direction and target position.
vehicle_restored.config.client.debug.ray: If true, the raytracer will be reloaded each tick.
vehicle_restored.config.client.debug.pro: If true, the vehicle properties will be reloaded each tick.
If true, when rendering debug outlines all interactable boxes will be rendered rather than just the active ones.
vehicle_restored.config.client.interacti: If true, raytraces will be performed on nearby vehicles when left-clicking the mouse, rather than just right-clicking it. This allows one to be damaged/broken when clicking anywhere on it, rather than just on its bounding box.
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.s: If true, displays a speedometer on the HUD when driving a vehicle
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.a: If true, automatically switches to third person when mounting vehicles
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.f: If enabled, camera perspective will always be forced back to first person when exiting a vehicle.
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.w: If true, an animation is performed while cycling vehicles in the workstation
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.r: If true, automatically rotates the camera when turning in a vehicle
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.h: The amount of segments to use to render the hose on a gas pump. The lower the value, the better the performance but renders a less realistically looking hose
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.i: If true, uses an improved camera system when riding vehicles. Disabling this option will restore the default camera but it will break the experience of some vehicles.
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.f: Makes the camera follow the vehicles traveling direction and rotations. This will be limited to yaw if immersiveCamera is disabled.
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.u: In third person, uses the vehicle as the focus point rather than the players head. This only has an effect when immersiveCamera is enabled.
vehicle_restored.config.client.display.s: Makes the camera follow vehicle rotations on the x-axis (pitch). This only has an effect when followVehicleOrientation is enabled.
Makes the camera follow vehicle rotations on the y-axis (yaw). This only has an effect when followVehicleOrientation is enabled.
Makes the camera follow vehicle rotations on the z-axis (roll). This only has an effect when followVehicleOrientation is enabled.
vehicle_restored.config.client.controlle: Configuration options for controller support (Must have Controllable installed)
If true, will use the triggers on controller to control the acceleration of the vehicle.
vehicle_restored.config.server.fuel_enab: If true, vehicles will require fuel for them to be driven.
vehicle_restored.config.server.vehicle_d: If true, vehicles will take damage.
vehicle_restored.config.server.pick_up_v: Allows players to pick up vehicles by crouching and right clicking
vehicle_restored.config.server.fuel_cons: Change the amount of fuel vehicles consume by multiplying the consumption rate by this factor
vehicle_restored.config.server.trailer_d: The distance threshold before the trailer detaches from a vehicle
vehicle_restored.config.server.trailer_s: The amount of ticks to wait before syncing data to clients about the trailer connection. This is important for smooth trailer movement on client side.
vehicle_restored.config.server.trailer_i: The amount of ticks to wait before syncing trailer inventory to tracking clients. If the value is set to 0 or less, the inventory will not sync and will save on network usage.
vehicle_restored.config.server.max_hose_: The maximum distance before the hose from the gas pump or fluid hose breaks
vehicle_restored.config.server.gas_pump_: The fluid capacity of the gas pump in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.pump_tran: The amount of fluid a pump will transfer each tick
vehicle_restored.config.server.fluid_pum: The fluid capacity of the fluid pump in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.fluid_ext: The amount of ticks before fluid is extracted from an item
The fluid capacity of the fluid extractor in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.fluid_mix: The amount of ticks to mix fluids together
The input fluid capacity of the fluid mixer in millibuckets
The output fluid capacity of the fluid mixer in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.fuel_drum: The fluid capacity of the fuel drum in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.industria: The fluid capacity of the industrial fuel drum in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.jerry_can: The fluid capacity of the jerry can in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.industria: The fluid capacity of the industrial jerry can in millibuckets
vehicle_restored.config.server.jerry_can: The amount of fluid transferred when pouring or filling a jerry can
vehicle_restored.config.server.spray_can: The amount of sprays before a spray can becomes empty
vehicle_restored.status.invalid_owner: You are not the owner of this vehicle

vehicle_restored.status.key_invalid: This key does not fit this vehicle
